factions.name: Team Drift
factions.philosophy: The floating islands are fragile. Only by harnessing gravity crystals to stabilize the region can catastrophe be prevented — even if relocation of towns is necessary.
factions.motivation: Stabilize the Celestide Isles via engineered gravity-crystal control before islands collapse or drift apart.

known_members.notes: Field leader. Calm, logical engineer. Commands crystal-retrieval operations.
Support specialist. Nervous but kind. Handles crystal diagnostics and civilian evacuation protocols.
Engineers in light gear with crystal tools — not sinister. Use Flying or Electric types. Will retreat when outmatched.

factions.notes: Team Drift members can retreat, surrender, or be reasoned with. First encounter: Wind Festival crystal theft at Skysong Harbor (Session 1). Not irredeemable villains.
